jobs.title: Day Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**AbilityPath is hiring for Day Program Coordinator**

*Are you passionate about making a difference in the lives of adults with diverse abilities?*

**JOIN OUR TEAM** to facilitate site-based and community integrated group learning activities and empower adults with developmental and intellectual disabilities to lead fulfilling lives.

**Compensation: $29-$30/hour** (based on education and experience)

**Schedule:** Full Time Position, Daly City

**WHAT WE OFFER – Employee Benefits**:

At AbilityPath, we support career development, employee wellness, and recognition.

* 4 weeks of PTO
* 10 paid holidays
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits upon hire
* 401(k) plan with employer match
* Performance bonuses
* Educational reimbursement for ongoing professional development
* Mileage reimbursement

  

**WHO WE ARE**:

AbilityPath is a non-profit organization that provides a lifespan of services for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Our mission is to accept, respect, and include people of all abilities. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) learning and building an inclusive community.

**ABOUT THE ROLE – What we value:**

* **Lead & Develop Staff:** Provide mentorship, coaching, training, and supervision to instructors, interns, and volunteers.
* **Support Meaningful Programming:** Oversee curriculum planning and engaging, person-centered activities that promote independence, skill development, and community participation.
* **Coordinate Participant Services:** Support individualized goals, service planning, and collaboration with families, caregivers, and community partners.
* **Drive Program Excellence:** Partner with program leadership to ensure smooth daily operations, accurate documentation, and high-quality services.
* **Build Community Connections:** Develop partnerships that expand vocational, recreational, and community-based opportunities for participants.
* **Make a Direct Impact:** Stay connected to the individuals we serve by providing hands-on program support and instruction when needed.

  

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:**

Below is a list of education and work experience qualifications**. We encourage you to apply even if you may not meet all the listed qualifications and you are interested in joining our team.**

* 1+ years previous work or volunteer experience supporting adults with disabilities
* Associate degree or working towards completion

**AbilityPath is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse staff; we strongly encourage BIPOC, LGBTQ+ and marginalized candidates to apply!**

**HIRING REQUIREMENTS****:**

* Valid California Driver's License/ID and license for at least 3 years if under age of 25
* Clean driving record of 3 years ( minor infractions ok)
* Proof of negative TB test results
* Verification of occupational physical clearance
* Pass a criminal fingerprint clearance
* 18 years of age or job permit clearance

  

**PHYSICAL ACTIVITY:**

Instructor responsibilities include the physical support of children:

* Physical stamina to lead learning activities: sit, stand, and bend frequently
* Ability to drive vehicle and transport adults with disabilities
* Lift up to 25 lbs. as needed

We encourage applicants to share their access needs during the interview process, upon hire, and ongoing throughout their employment. AbilityPath is committed to making our organization accessible to meet the needs of our team members.

**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY:**

Learning Links is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best available persons in every job. Our policy prohibits unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), color, national origin, gender identity, gender expression, ancestry (including language-use restrictions and possession of a driver's license), citizenship, physical or mental disability, genetic characteristics, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, family care status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, legally protected medical condition, military or veteran status, or other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. AbilityPath will not tolerate any unlawful discrimination against, harassment of, or disrespectful or unprofessional conduct toward an employee based upon any of the protected characteristics listed above or based on the perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is **unlawful.**

jobs.title: Community Health Worker
jobs.description:
*Empowering Wellness, Transforming Lives*

Optima Medical Management Group is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life by promoting wellness. At Optima MMG and all of its divisions: Serene Health, Community Support, and American TrueCare, our mission is to provide comprehensive support and care that not only addresses immediate concerns but also fosters long-term well-being.

As pioneers in the field, we aspire to lead in member care outcomes and set new standards for excellence and innovation. We are committed to empowering our members to achieve self-sufficiency in health, creating a ripple effect that strengthens families and communities.

Our work culture at Optima MMG is built on pride, passion, and a collective commitment to making a positive difference in people's lives. Our team members are dedicated problem-solvers who bring their unique skills and perspectives to the table. We believe that by fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, we can unlock the full potential of our team and, in turn, provide the best possible care to our members.

A career at Optima MMG is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organization. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth, providing our employees with access to industry experts, cutting-edge technologies, and a supportive community that values each individual's contributions. Join us on this journey to not only advance your career but to be a driving force in transforming lives and communities through passionate and fulfilling work!

**Job Summary:**

The Community Health Worker (CHW) serves as a trusted liaison between community members, healthcare providers, and social service organizations. Working as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod's interdisciplinary Care Team, alongside Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs, the CHW is responsible for conducting outreach, providing health education, addressing social determinants of health, and connecting members to medical, behavioral health, and community-based resources. Under the general supervision of Enhanced Care Management Leadership, the CHW works closely with members, families, care teams, and community partners to improve health outcomes, promote self-sufficiency, and reduce barriers to care; working mainly remotely alongside the Lead Care Managers for direct member engagement. This position requires strong communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and a passion for serving diverse populations.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary team member to conduct in-person visits to community members and provide education on health-related topics.

* Assist individuals in accessing healthcare services, social services, and community resources.

* Assess social determinants of health and identify barriers impacting member well-being and healthcare access.

* Support care coordination activities and collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, social workers, and community agencies.

* Function as an integral, mostly remote member of the pod Care Team, partnering closely with Lead Care Managers, MAs, and RNs who conduct direct member engagement.

* Accompany members to appointments when appropriate and assist with healthcare system, insurance program, and benefit enrollment navigation.

* Maintain ongoing contact with members through phone calls, home visits, community outreach, and telehealth platforms.

* Document member interactions, assessments, and referrals accurately and timely in designated systems.

* Advocate for members and assist with resolving barriers that interfere with access to care and services.

* Participate in community outreach events, health fairs, educational workshops, and engagement activities.

* Maintain member confidentiality and comply with all organizational and regulatory requirements.

* Participate in regularly scheduled member huddles for updates and feedback.

* Reporting in-person to the office as needed for meetings.

* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  

**Populations of Focus:**

* **Individuals experiencing homelessness:** Lacking a fixed, regular, and adequate nighttime residence.

* **Individuals at risk for avoidable hospital or emergency department utilization:** Five or more emergency room visits in a six-month period that could have been avoided with appropriate outpatient care or improved treatment adherence.

* **Individuals with Serious Mental Health and/ or substance use disorder needs:** Adults who meet the eligibility criteria for participation in, or obtaining services through Specialist mental health services or the Drug Medi-Cal organized delivery system or Drug Medi-Cal program.

* **Individuals transitioning from incarceration/Justice Involved:** Adults transitioning from a correctional setting or transitioned from a correction setting within the past 12 months, or children and youth who are transitioning from a youth correctional facility or transitioned from being in a youth correctional facility within the past 12 months.

* **Adults living in the community and at risk for long-term care institutionalization:** Adults who are living in the community who meet the SNF Level of Care criteria; or who require lower-acuity skilled nursing or equipment for prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of acute illness or injury.

* **Adult nursing facility residents transitioning to the community:** Adult nursing residents who are interested in moving out of the institution, and are likely candidates to do so successfully, and are able to reside continuously in the community.

* **Children and youth enrolled in California Children's Services (CCS) or CCS Whole Child Model (WCM) with Additional Needs Beyond the CCS condition:** Children and youth enrolled in CCS or CCS WCM and are experiencing at least one complex social factor influencing their health.

* **Children and Youth Involved in Child Welfare**

* **Individuals with Intellectual/ Developmental Disabilities:** Adu

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**GENERAL SUMMARY**

The Bay Club Operations Associate is an exciting opportunity to gain experience across multiple areas of Club operations while creating memorable experiences for members and guests every day. It's more than a support role; Associates contribute to the overall success of the Club by supporting hospitality, fitness, facility operations, and member services. This role provides a unique opportunity to explore different departments, build valuable skills, and discover potential career paths within the organization. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy variety, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and are excited to develop new skills while building a foundation for future advancement. Bay Club Associates are expected to deliver outstanding service, uphold safety and cleanliness standards, support daily Club operations, and bring a positive, energetic, and professional attitude to every interaction.

  

**Our Culture**

Our unique culture is at the heart of all we do and is guided by our values and behaviors. It's what we expect of ourselves and each other every day. We call it our "Code of Culture".

Our Code of Culture includes Our Mantra, Our Actions We Live By, and Pete's Promise:

**Our Mantra:**

Respect The Past

Accept Responsibility

Pay it Forward

**Our Actions We Live By:**

**Actions We Live By**. It's who we are when we step into our full power.

**Keep It Real. Always.** We need open and honest discussions. We need courage to speak up and to call things out that aren't good enough. And we navigate tough conversations with empathy and grace.

**Think Ahead. Be An Owner**. Always be proactive, not reactive; be on the front foot. If we want to be an owner of this business, we must act like it!

**Stay Humble. Hustle Harder.** Show up and do the hard work. Be a gritty, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of crew. Know it's never about one person-we are a part of a powerful team.

**One Team. One Voice.** Be ONE united team. When we move in the same direction, there are no limits to what we can accomplish.

**Be Curious. Ask Why**. Stay member curious. We seek to understand, and we never settle. We ask questions to truly understand the core of a matter.

**Pete's Promise:**

Service Forward

Ruthlessly Consistent

Do the Right Thing

**Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.**

### **PRIMARY JOB FUNCTIONS**

### **Club Cleanliness & Housekeeping**

* Maintain cleanliness and appearance standards throughout assigned Club areas, including fitness spaces, locker rooms, lobby, reception desks, pool areas, restrooms, and common areas.
* Perform detail cleaning and preventive maintenance activities.
* Restock supplies, amenities, janitorial products, and inventory items.
* Assist with laundry operations, including collecting, washing, drying, and folding towels.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment.
* Identify and communicate maintenance and cleanliness issues requiring further attention.

### **Customer Service & Member Experience**

* Greet members and guests upon arrival and throughout the Club.
* Check members and guests into the Club and applicable activity areas.
* Ensure guest registration requirements and applicable fees are completed.
* Book appointments, programs, services, and class reservations.
* Provide information regarding Club amenities, programming, events, and services.
* Deliver exceptional service experiences to members, guests, and fellow Associates.
* Build positive relationships with members and guests through proactive engagement and responsiveness.
* Represent the Club professionally through image, communication, follow-through, and responsiveness.
* Assist in generating membership and program leads by identifying prospective member interest.

### **Reception & Operational Support**

* Answer and transfer incoming phone calls.
* Assist with property tours and membership sales as needed.
* Operate point-of-sale systems and cash registers.
* Process payments and member account charges.
* Complete opening and closing duties for assigned operational areas.
* Support Club events, programs, and special activities.
* Assist in operational coverage across departments as business needs require.

### **Fitness Operations**

* Provide general supervision of fitness and recovery areas.
* Ensure fitness and recovery spaces are clean, safe, organized, and operating according to Club policies and procedures.
* When appropriate, instruct members on the proper and safe use of fitness equipment.
* Monitor fitness floor conditions and report equipment issues or safety concerns.
* Ensure equipment, accessories, and recovery amenities are properly organized and maintained.
* Monitor music, televisions, and overall environmental conditions within fitness areas.
* Maintain exceptional member service standards within fitness facilities.
* Support fitness programs, events, and departmental initiatives as assigned.

### **Pool Deck & Hospitality Support (If Applicable)**

* Welcome members and guests to the pool and recreation areas.
* Assist with seating, amenities, and event support.
* Maintain refreshment stations and towel operations.
* Assist with setup, breakdown, and cleanliness of designated areas.

### **Communication & Teamwork**

* Communicate timely and effectively with managers, team members, and members.
* Follow up on assigned tasks and member requests.
* Participate actively in required meetings, events, trainings, and development opportunities.
* Collaborate across departments to ensure operational excellence and a seamless member experience.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by management.

### **Other Job Functions**

* Work a flexible schedule that may include mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Provide support across multiple departments based on Club operational needs and business demands.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**OUR COMPANY:**

EOS IT Solutions is a Global Technology and Logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world's largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of service are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

We are a true International IT provider and are proud to deliver our services through global simplicity with trusted transparency.

### **What You Will Do**

The **Senior Program Operations Manager** reports to the EOS Service Delivery Manager and provides hands-on execution and program administration support to keep the defined program of work on track.

Working closely with the client Service Manager, the Senior Program Operations Manager owns the day-to-day operational detail. This includes coordinating logistics, tracking progress against the agreed plan, maintaining financial and status reporting, and surfacing risks early so delivery stays aligned to the scope, standards, and timeline the client has defined.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Execution & Delivery Support**

* Act as the day-to-day execution partner for the defined program of work by interpreting the agreed scope and plan, coordinating activities, and maintaining accurate plans, trackers, and reporting.
* Own the operational detail and program administration workload on behalf of the EOS Service Delivery Manager, enabling focus on strategic decisions, KPIs, and stakeholder relationships.

#### **Program Planning & Governance**

* Maintain live tracking against the client-owned Plan of Record (PoR), ensuring milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and status remain current and aligned to the agreed plan and timeline.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, and interdependencies; escalate through the EOS Service Delivery Manager; and recommend mitigation options for client review and decision-making.

#### **Financial Reporting & Spend Tracking**

* Track and report spend, commitments, and forecast changes against client-approved hardware budgets, providing clear visibility into project financial performance.
* Maintain accurate project-level cost tracking and identify spend variances, overruns, or scope-related changes early to support informed client decisions.
* Prepare bills of materials (BOMs), cost summaries, and cost-to-complete forecasts for client review and approval as requested.

#### **Reporting & Communication**

* Provide regular program status updates and supporting data to the EOS Service Delivery Manager, highlighting progress, risks, blockers, and items requiring client decisions.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting packages that consolidate program health, budget performance, and delivery milestones into a single view.
* Ensure reporting is timely, accurate, and tailored to the appropriate audience, while supporting Quarterly Business Review (QBR) preparation.

### **ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:**

* 6+ years of operational or program management experience within an audiovisual (AV), collaboration technology, or AV construction environment.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.
* Proficiency with project management software and tools to coordinate workstreams, monitor progress, and deliver results against established timelines.
* Experience coordinating vendors and delivery resources across multiple projects.
* Experience with forecasting, budget management, financial reporting, and delivery KPIs, including on-time delivery, milestone adherence, compliance, data quality, and forecast accuracy.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, including the ability to clearly communicate risks, impacts, and recommendations.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* High integrity and discretion when handling confidential information.

### **DESIRABLE CRITERIA:**

* Working knowledge of audiovisual and video conferencing platforms, including Cisco, Neat, Zoom, and Google Meet.
* Experience with digital signage and enterprise audio systems.
* Familiarity with AV-over-IP technologies, unified communications platforms, and IT infrastructure integrations.
* ITIL v4 certification or higher.
* Experience applying Lean or Six Sigma methodologies to improve service delivery, reduce operational costs, or enhance quality.
* Experience driving operational improvements through process optimization, reporting automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

*The EOS pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, market data, or other laws.*

*EOS is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at EOS regardless of your gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non-merit factor.*

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW:

**Experience** a place of energy, passion, and excitement. A place where the joy of discovery and uncommon artistry blend to create exhilarating buying experiences—for true beauty enthusiasts. At Ulta Beauty, we’re transforming the world one shade, one lash, one cut at a time. Because beauty is powerful.

If you seek **greater purpose**—a place of vision, mission, and lived values—where voices are heard, contributions valued and recognized and growth opportunities abound, consider Ulta Beauty. Nowhere else are the possibilities quite this beautiful.

  
:

**GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for leading through Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values in order to develop a high-performing team that consistently delivers top-line sales growth for the store. The OM leads a team of Task Associates and the Merchandise Manager (MM), and is responsible for supporting the management of the operations of a retail store, including realignments, planograms and inventory life cycle-related processes (e.g., cycle counts, damages, testers, Return To Vendors (RTV), Destroy in Field (DIF) and inventory adjustments). This leader drives the store’s retail business through a focus on performance (sales, inventory results, and operational compliance), people (talent acquisition, training and development), and process (standard operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires a passion for operational excellence, a drive for results, the ability to quickly and efficiently lead through unforeseen complexity, and the ability to lead, influence, and develop their team.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES** (\*Essential Job Functions)

The OM is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

**Performance**

* Promote a culture of accountability to meet or exceed the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), payroll, omni-channel, and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty for the store.
* Drive company profitability through operational excellence, top-line sales growth, and expense control.
* Leverage store forecast and payroll budgets to support with store scheduling needs and communicate the needs to the GM to maximize productivity, achieve sales and payroll goals, and complete workload (e.g., realignments, planograms, and ad set processes) on time, and within the payroll budget.
* Review, analyze and react to Ulta Beauty’s financial and operational reporting, including store visit and audit results, regularly and in a timely manner.
* Leverage company programs, tools, and resources to drive improvements to meet Ulta Beauty’s goals for the store.
* Perform makeup applications, skincare analysis, and product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and guest service experience.
* Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
* Maintain prompt, regular attendance as the OM and hold store associates accountable to the Ulta Beauty attendance policy.

**People**

* Attract, hire, and retain a diverse team of top talent, and efficiently address any staffing needs and open positions for the store.
* Build a highly engaged team at the store that embodies the Ulta Beauty brand through effective collaboration, open and honest communication, and prioritization of work.
* Create an inclusive environment that inspires and encourages the growth and engagement of associates.
* Support all aspects of manager and associate professional development, including training, providing individualized competency-based feedback and coaching, performance reviews, succession planning, and individual development plans to enable continuous development and drive sales performance.
* Regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
* Ensure direct reports regularly participate in ongoing training, including brand and category education, to enable continuous professional development and drive sales performance.
* Establish professional vendor partnerships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering on shipment and planogram expectations.

**About the Office of the City Administrator:**

The Office of the City Administrator includes 20+ agencies and over 1,000 dedicated staff who provide essential services to San Francisco residents and businesses and improve the administration of government.  
  
Our Mission  
The City Administrator’s Office is strongly committed to ensuring efficient and effective government services, increasing the City’s safety and resiliency, strengthening the local economy, supporting equity and inclusion, and optimizing the City’s capital planning and infrastructure.

Our Vision

We are committed to ensuring that the City's services are inclusive, efficient, equitable, and culturally competent for San Franciscans of all races, ethnic backgrounds, religions, and sexual orientations. This commitment requires comprehensive review and thorough analysis of existing practices and policies to remove barriers to real inclusion.

We are also committed to ensuring that the Department is a safe, equitable, and inclusive workplace for individuals of all races. This includes creating opportunities for hiring, promotion, retention, training, and development, for all employees, including but not limited to Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC).

To learn more about our departments, divisions, and programs, visit: https://sf.gov/departments/city-administrator

**About the Real Estate Division**

The Office of the City Administrator, Real Estate Division (RED) is a team of more than 300 staff delivering professional real estate services to a variety of City departments. RED supports San Francisco’s public mission by delivering two essential services:

**Real Estate Transactions and Property Records:** RED manages acquisitions, conveyance, and leasing of real property on behalf of City departments, as well as conducting and documenting these transactions efficiently, transparently, and in alignment with City policies, operational needs, and reporting requirements.

**Property and Facility Management:** RED provides services to over 6 million square feet of City-owned property, including civic facilities such as City Hall, 49 South Van Ness, the Hall of Justice, Alemany Farmers Market, Police Headquarters, and other key public assets. Our property management, building engineering, contracts, security and custodial teams provide operational support to keep City services running safely and effectively.

 **Job Description**

RED is seeking an experienced manager to serve as the Division Administration and Operations Manager. This position serves as a core member of RED’s executive leadership team and provides division-wide management, policy development, operational planning, and resource allocation across multiple functional areas such as procurement and contracting, budget and financial management, lease administration and accounts payable, portfolio information and analytics, real property records, business and technology systems, administrative services, and Human Resources functions.

This position reports directly to the Director of Real Estate and oversees managers, supervisors, analysts, and administrative staff that support RED’s operational needs. This position is responsible for building and implementing effective business processes, establishing clear ownership and service standards, strengthening staff and supervisory capacity, and ensuring that RED’s operational infrastructure supports the Division’s statutory responsibilities, property operations, real estate services, and major citywide initiatives.

The ideal candidate is an experienced manager with strong experience in leading complex administrative and business functions, navigating public-sector processes, developing and overseeing staff, solving cross-functional operating challenges, and translating executive priorities into effective day-to-day operations.

**Examples of Important and Essential Duties**

**Leadership & Organizational Management**

* Provide division-wide leadership of RED’s core business and administrative operations, establishing clear accountability, priorities, roles, and service expectations across all operational units.
* Advise RED senior leadership on operational, administrative, financial, organizational, and personnel issues; provide guidance and recommendations.
* Direct, supervise and develop managers, supervisors, analysts, and administrative staff, ensuring strong performance, professional growth, and effective team operations.
* Identify and address operational gaps, resolve cross-functional issues, and strengthen management processes to improve overall division performance.

**Human Resources Coordination**

* Serve as RED’s primary management liaison to Human Resources on workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, and employee development.
* Support managers in workforce and personnel needs across RED; resolve related matters

**Budget & Financial Management**

* Oversee RED’s budgeting and financial operations in coordination with the City Administrator’s Office Finance & Accounting team.
* Ensure effective financial planning, forecasting, expenditure and revenue monitoring, and management reporting.

As Render grows and prepares for an office move, you’ll work with People leadership, Finance, and an outside real estate advisor to make the move run smoothly. **About the job**

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

In this role as a Product Planning Program Manager (PgM), you will join a dedicated team of planners tasked with analyzing the capacity demands of our product areas. Your primary focus will be ensuring Google maintains the optimal infrastructure specifically compute machinery. You will lead demand-supply planning and execution for critical AI/ML compute products. Partnering closely with internal stakeholders across planning, procurement, logistics, and finance, you will oversee product planning operations that empower Google's expanding cloud infrastructure. Additionally, you will drive cross-functional collaboration to define requirements for new workflows and software platforms, aligning key teams to facilitate strategic decision-making and support sustainable, efficient, and predictable growth.

This team is responsible for enabling and accelerating Google's data center infrastructure growth and delivery through AI-Powered Supply Chain Planning for all of Google, drive planning decisions for new technology, and supply capability across data centers, networking, and machines. The team focuses on driving the forecasting, demand and supply planning, execution capability/feasibility management of data center compute & storage infrastructure products.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

jobs.description:
**Who we are:**

For over 25 years, Global Relay has set the standard in enterprise information archiving with industry-leading cloud archiving, surveillance, eDiscovery, and analytics solutions. We securely capture and preserve the communications data of the world's most highly regulated firms, giving them greater visibility and control over their information and ensuring compliance with stringent regulations.

Though we offer competitive compensation and benefits and all the other perks one would expect from an established company, we are not your typical technology company. Global Relay is a career-building company. A place for big ideas. New challenges. Groundbreaking innovation. It's a place where you can genuinely make an impact – and be recognized for it.

We believe great businesses thrive on diversity, inclusion, and the contributions of all employees. To that end, we recruit candidates from different backgrounds and foster a work environment that encourages employees to collaborate and learn from each other, completely free of barriers.

**Your role:**

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Global Relay, you will be the primary point of contact and a trusted advisor to a portfolio of customers across our SMB and Mid-Market segment. You will drive value realization, adoption, and growth by building strong relationships, understanding business objectives, and aligning our solutions to customer needs. You will manage and expand customer engagement across multiple departments, lead renewal and expansion conversations, and mitigate churn risk. You will also collaborate with internal teams to ensure satisfaction throughout the customer lifecycle.

This role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about customer advocacy, enjoy working cross-functionally, and thrive in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Act as the primary point of contact for your customer portfolio, building trusted relationships across both operational and executive stakeholders
* Own renewal strategy and drive gross revenue retention, upsell, cross-sell, and multi-year commitments
* Identify and execute on expansion opportunities through data analysis, usage trends, and business objectives
* Serve as the primary escalation point for customer issues, coordinating with Support, Product, and Client Services to resolve challenges
* Build and execute account plans that balance growth and risk mitigation
* Understand customer objectives, align Global Relay solutions, and proactively deliver insights, benchmarking, and best practices
* Create customer champions and advocate for customer needs internally
* Conduct regular Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) with accounts, using data-driven insights to reinforce value and secure renewal commitments
* Participate in strategic customer programs, feedback sessions, training initiatives, and industry events
* Enhance customers' target operating models and optimize to improve satisfaction and usage
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date information in Salesforce CRM

**About you:**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Strategic Client Services — preferably in SaaS, financial services, compliance, or a regulated industry
* Proven ability to manage a portfolio of mid-sized accounts with varying degrees of complexity
* Strategic thinker with the ability to communicate clearly and influence across all levels, including executives
* Comfortable analyzing customer data to uncover insights, drive adoption, and identify risks or opportunities
* Excellent project management, communication, and presentation skills
* Experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM platform
* Resourceful, proactive, and collaborative with a strong customer-first mindset
* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree is a plus

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience working with mid-market customers in a compliance-driven SaaS environment
* Prior involvement in creating or scaling customer success playbooks or enablement initiatives
* Experience with customer lifecycle programs, customer journey mapping, or voice-of-customer programs

**What you can expect:**

At Global Relay, there's no ceiling to what you can achieve. It's the land of opportunity for the energetic, the intelligent, the driven. You'll receive the mentoring, coaching, and support you need to reach your career goals. You'll be part of a culture that breeds creativity and rewards perseverance and hard work. And you'll be working alongside smart, talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with complementary knowledge and skills.

Global Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We seek to ensure reasonable adjustments, accommodations, and personal time are tailored to meet the unique needs of every individual.

To learn more about our business, culture, and community involvement, visit www.globalrelay.com.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**About Sycamore**
==================

Sycamore is building the trusted agent operating system for the enterprise. Our platform helps companies build, deploy, and orchestrate agentic apps that take on real operational work, with the security and control large organizations need.

We are a small, engineering-led team working directly with Fortune 500 enterprises. We have raised $65M from Coatue and Lightspeed, along with other investors and industry leaders.

**The role**
============

Strategy & Operations at Sycamore is a generalist role for someone who is good at reducing messy problems to clear decisions and then making the decision stick. There is no fixed remit. In a given quarter the highest-leverage work might be the model that decides how we price a deployment, the reporting that tells us whether deployments are actually succeeding, the planning cycle that sets company priorities, or an internal process that is quietly costing everyone hours.

You will work directly with the founders and with engineering, commercial, and recruiting leaders. Most of the work is analytical: getting the data, understanding what it says, and forming a recommendation you are willing to defend. The rest is operational follow-through, which is where most of the value is and where most people stop. The scope grows with what you demonstrate.

**What you will do**
====================

* Own analytical and operational problems end to end, from framing through recommendation through implementation.
* Run company planning, goal setting, and the review cadence that keeps them honest.
* Design and improve internal processes and systems across finance, recruiting operations, vendor management, and commercial operations.
* Support pricing, deal structuring, and commercial analysis alongside the go-to-market team.
* Find the work nobody owns yet, take it on, and hand it off well once it is systematized.
* Write clearly for an audience of founders, engineers, and customers.

**What we are looking for**
===========================

* 4-10 years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, banking, product operations, or a generalist role at a high-growth company. We will make exceptions for exceptional people in either direction.
* Strong analytical ability. You can build a model, query data directly, and tell the difference between a real signal and an artifact of how the data was collected.
* Evidence of operational follow-through. You have implemented recommendations, not only produced them.
* Comfort with ambiguity and no established playbook. Much of this role is deciding what deserves attention.
* Clear writing. Your recommendations should be understandable to someone who was not in the room.
* Technical fluency. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data yourself and understand what our product does at more than a surface level.
* AI-native. You use modern AI systems and agents to expand your own throughput, while owning the judgment and the conclusions.
* High integrity with numbers. You would rather present an uncomfortable finding than a flattering one.

**Interview process**
=====================

* A 30-minute introductory conversation.
* Two 60-minute conversations, one on analytical problem solving and one on operational judgment.
* A working session where you take a real, open Sycamore problem, do the analysis, and present a recommendation you would be willing to own.

**Why join**
============

* Work directly with the founders on the decisions that shape the company.
* Take on genuinely varied problems rather than one narrow function.
* Build the operating foundation of a company early enough that it compounds.
* Work alongside engineers building something technically hard, in a company where operations is expected to keep up.
* Receive competitive cash compensation and meaningful equity in the company you are helping build.

Own the technical client relationship throughout each Audience engagement, leading technical and operational discussions, setting expectations, providing guidance and coordinating issue resolution and escalations.

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Translate prioritized needs into actionable scope, requirements, sequencing, timelines, and delivery plans. Assess cross-project and platform dependencies, clarify ownership, and apply governance to support informed prioritization and delivery.

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Web Strategist professional we seek is a collaborator with these qualifications.

Doctorate degree and 2 years of digital or web program, project, governance and technology experience

jobs.description:
**Make an impact**

  

The Program Manager, Technical Solutions owns the business platforms that support Bridge Property Management’s maintenance, capital expenditure (CapEx), and annual budgeting processes. This role leads the implementation of BPM's next-generation maintenance platform, partners with the CapEx team to extend our CapEx platform to the unit renovation process, and manages the annual budgeting platform.

Acting as the technical partner to the VP Service & Facilities, the CapEx Director, and Asset Management, the Program Manager translates platform capabilities into better business processes, resolves technical issues, and uses automation to improve how site teams, CapEx teams, and asset managers work.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintenance Platform Ownership: Lead the planning, configuration, testing, rollout, and adoption of BPM’s next-generation maintenance platform, including the transition from the legacy application. Understand how site teams perform against maintenance KPIs such as work order response, completion, and unit turn times, and use that insight to shape configuration, reporting, and improvements.

* CapEx Platform Ownership: Own the CapEx platform and partner with the CapEx Director to extend it from exterior projects to the unit renovation process, including workflow design, configuration, and rollout.

* Budget Platform Ownership: Own the annual budgeting platform, including configuration, user access, and technical support through the budget cycle. Support the Operations, CapEx, and Asset Management teams as they build and enter their budgets.

* Process Optimization & Automation: Identify opportunities to improve maintenance, CapEx, and budgeting processes through platform capabilities and automation, and communicate what the systems can do so business leaders can make better decisions.

* Platform Support & Vendor Management: Manage user access and permissions, resolve technical issues, and manage vendor relationships, including release testing, support, and escalation.

* Program Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams to deliver platform initiatives with detailed plans, timelines, and resource allocations.

* Training, Adoption & Change Management: Partner with Talent Development to design and deliver training, and lead change management for platform updates and rollouts.

* Stakeholder Engagement: Hold regular reviews with the VP Service & Facilities, CapEx Director, and Asset Management on project progress, platform health, and KPIs.

* Governance, Compliance & Documentation: Ensure platforms meet internal policies, data governance standards, and security protocols, and maintain documentation for configurations, processes, and training materials.

**What you should bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field

* 5 years of experience in program or project management within a business technology or enterprise applications environment

* Experience with property management service and maintenance platforms such as HappyCo, SuiteSpot, Yardi Maintenance IQ, EliseAI Maintenance, or SmartOps

* Demonstrated process optimization experience, including the use of automation to improve workflows

* Experience leading platform implementations from planning through adoption

* Ability to translate business needs into platform configuration and communicate system capabilities to non-technical leaders

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

* Experience with CapEx, project management, or budgeting platforms

* Familiarity with maintenance KPIs in multifamily or residential property management

* PMP or similar certification

**What you can be a part of**  
As Program Manager, Technical Solutions, you’ll lead the rollout of Bridge Property Management’s next-generation maintenance platform, extend our CapEx platform to unit renovations, and own the annual budgeting platform. As the technical partner to the VP Service & Facilities, the CapEx Director, and Asset Management, you’ll turn platform capabilities into better processes and use automation to make life easier for site teams, CapEx teams, and asset managers. If you enjoy owning business-critical platforms and seeing your work improve how people get things done every day, this is a chance to make a visible, lasting impact.

  

The anticipated wage scale for this role is $104,000 - $130,000 per year. The hired applicant will also be eligible for an annual performance based discretionary bonus. The final pay offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and years of experience within the job, the type of years and experience within the industry, education, etc. Bridge Property Management is a multi-state employer, and this pay scale may not reflect positions that work in other states or locations.

At OLIPOP, we're on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we're doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that's delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn't be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben's vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we're also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we're committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let's write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

### **THE ROLE**

In this role, you will be intimately involved in the production process from start to finish. This starts with managing all things quality at both our premixing facilities, as well as finished good co-packers. The Quality Manager will be responsible for the design and management of the quality systems used to assure food safety, regulatory compliance and reliable product manufacturing with our USA suppliers, contract manufacturers and fulfillment partners.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Supplier Quality & Compliance**

* Own the supplier qualification, approval, and compliance program, ensuring suppliers and materials meet established quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements.

* Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain.

* Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments, considering material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data.

* Lead supplier quality investigations, CAPAs, and escalations, ensuring effective root cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions.

* Ensure supplier compliance with OLIPOP requirements, including the Supplier Expectation Manual, specifications, quality standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

* Lead supplier audits and facility assessments and drive continuous improvement through strong supplier partnerships.

**Ingredient Quality Management**

* Own the ingredient positive release program, including COA review, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders.

* Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to ensure materials consistently meet established quality and food safety specifications.

* Oversee ingredient retain and traceability programs to support quality investigations and supplier performance evaluation.

* Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and drive appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition.

* Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to proactively identify and mitigate emerging risks.

**Quality Systems & Document Control**

* Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions.

* Establish and enforce standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archival, and retention.

* Ensure supplier compliance records are complete, current, and audit-ready.

* Lead periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures accurately reflect current practices and requirements.

* Drive continuous improvement of quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and efficiency.

**Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop and own supplier performance metrics and scorecards to monitor quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks.

* Establish supplier performance review and escalation processes, including improvement plans for high-risk or underperforming suppliers.

* Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and continuous improvement opportunities.

* Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance, escalation, and disqualification decisions.

* Provide leadership visibility to supplier quality risks, significant nonconformances, and unresolved corrective actions.

  

### **Skills/Experience Requirements**

jobs.title: Onboarding & Ramp Manager
jobs.description:
### **About Us**

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.  
  
The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.  
  
AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.  
  
The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.  
  
Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.  
  
Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

As the Onboarding & Ramp Manager at Endor Labs, you'll own how every new seller goes from day one to fully ramped. You'll run our onboarding program end to end, from virtual onboarding to our in-person bootcamp, for new hires across the US and EMEA. You will help our sellers apply a deeply technical platform to solve high level business challenges in the modern AI development world using proven Value Selling frameworks and methodologies.

### **About The Role**

As the Onboarding & Ramp Manager at Endor Labs, you'll own how every new seller goes from day one to fully ramped. You'll run our onboarding program end to end, from virtual onboarding to our in-person bootcamp, for new hires across the US and EMEA. You will help our sellers apply a deeply technical platform to solve high level business challenges in the modern AI development world using proven Value Selling frameworks and methodologies.

### **About You**

You've built or run onboarding and enablement for technical sales teams, and you know the application security testing (AST) market: SCA, SAST, container and supply chain security, and the people who buy them. You might have carried a bag, worked as a sales engineer, or come up through security, but you can explain reachability or a vulnerable dependency to a new AE in plain language. You measure success by how fast new hires ramp, not by how many trainings you deliver.

### **How You'll Make an Impact**

* **Own onboarding end to end:** Run our virtual onboarding program and in-person bootcamp for all new GTM hires.
* **Cut time to ramp:** Define ramp milestones (first meetings, pipeline, first closed deal and second closed deal), track every new hire against them, and fix the program where people get stuck.
* **Make the technical simple:** Build curriculum on the AppSec market, our platform, the competitive landscape, and our core buyer personas, from AppSec and DevSecOps leaders to CISOs and engineering leaders.
* **Certify readiness:** Create pitch, discovery, and demo certifications so new hires and their managers know when they're ready to sell.
* **Scale with hiring:** Build a program that can onboard large cohorts at once as we grow the GTM team, without losing quality.
* **Partner across the business:** Work with Sales leaders, Solutions Engineering, Product Marketing, and Recruiting to keep content current and give new hires the right coaching from day one.
* **Bridge time zones:** Schedule and deliver sessions that work for both US and EMEA cohorts.

### **What You Bring to the Table**

* 5+ years in sales enablement, sales training, sales engineering, or a quota-carrying role at a B2B security or developer tools company
* Working knowledge of the AST market (SCA, SAST, DAST, software supply chain security) is a must
* Track record of building onboarding programs that measurably shortened ramp time
* Strong & energetic facilitator who can lead a virtual session or a room of new hires with equal confidence
* Organized program owner who can run multiple cohorts and stakeholders at once
* Comfortable with Salesforce, Gong, and an LMS or enablement platform
* Based on the US East Coast, with willingness to travel for bootcamps

### **Why Endor Labs**

We’re building at the intersection of developer productivity and security, one of the fastest-growing spaces in software. Our developer-loved platform delivers measurable ROI, strong market momentum, and a customer base that deeply values our mission.  
  
At Endor Labs, we **think big, start small, and learn fast**. We take ownership, move with purpose, and always start with customer success. We debate with data, make the complex simple, and challenge each other with kindness and candor. We celebrate wins, learn from misses, and have fun along the way, because when our customers win, we all win.

**Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

Service Forward

### **About Us**

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.  
  
The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.  
  
AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Are you someone who understands banking operations and enjoys helping others learn? Do you have experience working with **Time Deposits (CD and IRA), Safe Deposit Box or New Accounts** and want to take that knowledge beyond the branch?

CSI is looking for an **Implementation Specialist - Time Deposits & Safe Deposit Box**, to support financial institutions through core conversions and implementations. This is a great opportunity for someone with banking experience who wants to grow into a more technical, client-facing role while helping banks successfully transition to CSI solutions.

**What You’ll Do**

As an Implementation Specialist, you'll be involved in client conversions from start to finish, with a primary focus on **Time Deposits and Safe Deposit Boxes, correspondent balancing, and general ledger unposted balancing.**

You’ll serve as a client-facing resource throughout the conversion process, helping ensure tasks are completed accurately and on schedule while training bank employees on their new systems and processes.

In this role, you will:

* Support implementations and conversions involving Time Deposits and Safe Deposit Boxes
* Balance Time Deposit and Safe Deposit Box activity and reconcile related control accounts
* Assist with balancing activities involving general ledger accounts, ACH activity, cash letters, and correspondent accounts
* Balance and repair unposted general ledger items
* Understand how CDs and IRAs work throughout their lifecycle, including account activity, distributions, and related banking processes
* Work directly with bank employees during conversions, helping them locate accounts, understand system functionality, and complete balancing activities
* Train client employees on CSI solutions and processes related to Time Deposits and other assigned products
* Serve as a consistent client-facing point of contact throughout assigned portions of the conversion
* Monitor assigned tasks and timelines to help keep conversions on schedule
* Partner with specialists supporting DDA, loans, cards, project management, and other areas of the conversion
* Stay current on CSI products and enhancements to provide effective client training and implementation support

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must Have**

* At least 2 years of relevant work experience
* Banking or financial institution experience
* Working knowledge of CDs and/or IRAs
* Experience that may include teller, frontline banking, new accounts, deposit operations, or similar banking responsibilities
* Understanding of how deposit accounts and transactions move through a financial institution
* Strong communication and customer service skills

* Ability to work directly with bank employees and explain processes in a clear, approachable way
* Basic Microsoft Excel skills, including copying/pasting information and using basic formulas
* Ability and willingness to travel as required for client conversions
* Education or job knowledge equivalent to college or university undergraduate education

**What Will Help You Stand Out**

* Back-office or deposit operations experience
* Strong IRA knowledge, including experience supporting IRA account activity and distributions
* Experience balancing deposit accounts, control accounts, or general ledger activity
* Experience with ACH, cash letters, or correspondent balancing
* Previous involvement with a core banking conversion or system implementation
* Experience training bank employees or customers
* Familiarity with CSI solutions or NuPoint

**Travel Requirements**

* Approximately **minimum 50%** travel, based on business needs and the conversion schedule
* Travel is typically Sunday through Friday during onsite conversions
* Some conversions may require up to two consecutive weeks onsite
* Saturday work is required during conversions to support balancing and go-live activities
* Travel frequency will vary based on conversion volume, bank size, and project complexity
* Ability to travel regularly and work a flexible schedule during conversion periods is required

**Why This Role?**

If you’ve built your banking knowledge at a branch, in new accounts, or within deposit operations and are ready for something different, this role gives you the opportunity to take that experience directly to CSI clients.

You’ll learn the implementation and conversion process, work with different financial institutions, expand your knowledge of banking technology, and become part of the team responsible for helping banks successfully transition to CSI.
